paragraphs: He is mentioned in Keritot 9a, speaking in the name of Rav Ada bar Ahavah.[^1]

notes.text: The saved Davidson Keritot9a scalar has Rav Idi bar Gershom reporting Rav Ada bar Ahavah. Both Rav titles are explicit in Hyman; the witness supports the chain and folio without importing the legal ruling.
